obligations.behavior: Split unit-stride vector load/store bursts cleanly at both 4 KiB (`0x1000`) AXI page boundaries and the 256-beat `AXI_MAX_BURST_LEN` limit across `EW8..EW64` and `AxiDataWidth=64/128`, accounting for initial unaligned beat byte offset so no burst crosses a 4 KiB page or loses tail beats when `num_bytes < max_burst_bytes < start_offset + num_bytes`.

obligations.behavior: Correctly rotate and commit non-aligned and `vstart > 0` byte streams across 4 64-bit lanes in `vldu.sv` and `vstu.sv` (including transfers `< 32` bytes wrapping across two VRF words, `vm=0` masked loads/stores, and back-to-back pipelined loads with differing `vstart`), preserving prestart, tail, and inactive elements without deadlock or premature commit.

Hold `store_pending_o` and defer `store_complete_o` / `pe_resp_o.vinsn_done` until all W bursts and B responses of a multi-burst vector store complete; enforce RAW (store-before-load) and WAR (load-before-store) AXI ordering across `vlsu.sv` and `addrgen.sv` for overlapping unit-stride and indexed scatter/gather (`VLXE`/`VSXE`) instructions; consume indexed lane offset words using `eew_vs2` without over-popping back-to-back indexed ops; and report exact `addrgen_exception_vstart_o` on misaligned active indexed elements.
